decision.explanation: Neither variant is promoted. The direct variant improves the 24-DOF chain about9% but repeatedly regresses ball/free about10% and spatial_ball14–17%. Retaining the original helper for rows shorter than8 reduces those losses, but the chain gain falls to3–4% and several small-model slowdowns of1–2% remain repeatable. Without an established representative workload weighting or performance parity, these are insufficient grounds for a general replacement. The active Solver_Kernels body is restored byte-for-byte to its pre-experiment state; both proved variants, all raw sessions and the diagnostic tools are retained locally. No earlier project changes were reverted.
decision.next_step: Investigate the checked integer rejection reduction in Add_Row_Disjoint: compare a bounded modular bit reduction with the existing count, prove the exact rejection/frame contracts at the smallest subprogram first, test every SIMD lane, then repeat integrated measurements. Do not suppress checks or infer C parity from profile percentages.
